title: Relax and Let Your Success Mechanism Work for You
coreMove: Prepare hard, decide clearly, then let trained skill and quiet incubation work without anxious control stealing attention from the present.

exampleSpecs.stakes: A forced answer could harden a weak product decision.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use Russell-style incubation after real data loading.

exampleSpecs.stakes: A practiced passage could freeze under excess control.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show learned skill needing trust during performance.

exampleSpecs.stakes: Overload could turn every ticket into background panic.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use the hourglass image to narrow attention.

exampleSpecs.stakes: After-action worry could crowd out live judgment on the next call.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Separate preparation worry from execution worry.

exampleSpecs.audience: lab analyst handling a stuck experiment
exampleSpecs.stakes: Another strained hour could add noise instead of insight.
